description: The session's CONFIRMED findings about speech recognition, banked as order-0 postulates the agent HOLDS — Concepts under a held Microtheory whose definition+why text the agent's OWN implication-harvester reads, so its OWN order-N derivative (order_n_postulates) can synthesize the next-capability gaps and its OWN compression selector (gap_prioritiser) can rank them. NOT hand-authored shapes: these are postulates (held facts) written in the agent's grounded vocabulary; the SHAPES the agent transfers from them are harvested from this same text by the agent's extractors, and the SELECTOR decides which derived implications are real gaps. The central confirmed win (REL-BAND relational-invariance decoder), the grounded NULLs (so the agent does not re-tread them), and the deep conceptual frame (decode=quantize-to-coherent-structure; the message is the filter; structure-invariant-to-serialization; fancy-Morse-code; log/multiplicative basis-invariance; bounded multiplicativity; composition is the (G,Gamma) path to scale).

concepts.name: relational_invariance_decoder_confirmed
concepts.definition: The CONFIRMED speaker-invariant speech decoder reads the relational structure that is invariant to serialization: ordinal band-RANK (which band is larger than which) plus whole-unit self-similarity, matched by native banded monotonic DP (DtwTo). It is the coherent QUANTIZER — it maps the continuous acoustic wave to the discrete coherent code rather than measuring the wave. Confirmed cross-speaker +7.75%, voiced-to-whisper 67.5% under a controlled falsifier, compounding cross-speaker x whisper 60.7%, and shuffle-clean (the signal is in the relational order, not the magnitudes). The rank/ratio representation is coherent in any base because the auditory world is logarithmic and multiplicative.
concepts.why: A discrete code carried through a negotiable continuous carrier: the discreteness lives in the DECODER, not in the signal. Reading band-RANK and unit self-similarity is reading structure that survives every serialization of the same message (loud<->soft, voiced<->whisper, speaker<->speaker), so the decoder generalises across senders. This is the relational, scale-invariant, basis-invariant representation that earlier blurry-magnitude features lacked.

concepts.name: message_is_the_filter_source_invariant
concepts.definition: The linguistic message is the FILTER (the vocal-tract resonances / the shaped spectral envelope), not the source (the glottal excitation). Speech is a source-filter system in which the source and the filter combine MULTIPLICATIVELY; because the filter is a linear filter acting on the source, the source can be separated out and the message read from the filter alone. The whisper falsifier ABLATES the source (no voicing) yet the message survives at 67.5%, confirming the message rides on the filter and is invariant to the excitation.
concepts.why: A linear filter is invertible, so the source and the filter (its resonances) can be separated / identified rather than left entangled. Reading the message means recovering the filter's resonances independent of whatever source excites them — exactly why a source-ablating manipulation (whisper) leaves the message recoverable. Source-invariance is the same invariance as speaker-invariance and loudness-invariance: invariance to the carrier.

concepts.name: structure_invariant_to_serialization
concepts.definition: Cross-speaker, voiced<->whisper, loud<->soft, and speech<->text are ONE invariance: the message is a discrete structure that is INVARIANT to its serialization through a negotiable carrier. Each pairing is a different serialization (a different sender's fist, a different excitation, a different loudness, a different modality) of the SAME underlying discrete code. Decoding across speakers is decoding through the sender's fist; the coherent representation discards everything carrier-specific and keeps only the relational structure that all serializations share.
concepts.why: If the same message can be realized by many different serializations, then the recoverable invariant is the structure they share, not any single serialization's surface values. A representation that is invariant to a multiplicative scale factor (cancelled by a ratio or a per-source normalisation) is the same kind of object: rank/ratio cancels the carrier's scale, leaving the structure. This unifies four apparently separate generalisation problems into one.

concepts.name: log_multiplicative_basis_invariance
concepts.definition: The auditory world is logarithmic and multiplicative: source and filter combine by multiplication, and the cochlea already represents frequency and intensity on a log scale. Under a logarithm a multiplicative combination becomes ADDITIVE and therefore SEPARABLE, which is why source and filter can be pulled apart and why ratios cancel a common scale. The coherent representation is consequently BASIS-INVARIANT: a rank or a ratio is coherent in any base (the 1/3-not-0.333 point — the relation, not its decimal expansion in one base). This is why re-choosing the audio basis is irrelevant to the rank decoder: all reasonable bases are log, and the cochlea is already log-right.
concepts.why: A multiplicative / length scale factor is cancelled by a ratio or a per-source normalisation, so a representation built on ratios and ranks removes the carrier's scale and is invariant to the choice of base. Multiplicativity (source x filter) is the core structure; the logarithm makes it additive and separable; bounded multiplicativity with finite bounds is the convergent, coherent form of the representation. The basis-invariance is why basis re-choice was a grounded null.

concepts.name: decode_is_comprehend_is_quantize_to_coherent_structure
concepts.definition: Recognition = decode = comprehend = QUANTIZE the continuous signal to the discrete coherent structure, rather than measure the continuous wave. Mapping a continuous acoustic dimension to a small set of discrete categories by a learned decision boundary yields sharp category edges with within-level collapse — the categorical-perception signature. Speech decoding is therefore one construction in the SAME composer / library / router / Gamma the agent uses for language: perceiving an utterance is comprehending it, a continuous-to-discrete category map under the language engine, not a separate perceptual pipeline.
concepts.why: Mapping a continuous dimension to a small set of discrete levels by a decision boundary produces the categorical-perception signature (good across-boundary, poor within-category discrimination). Unifying perception with the language engine means the decode construction composes the same admissible structures as language, so the discrete code recovered by perception is already in the form comprehension consumes. The quantiser IS the coherent representation: it keeps the relational structure and discards the carrier.

concepts.name: speech_is_fancy_morse_code
concepts.definition: Speech is a discrete code transmitted through a negotiable continuous carrier — fancy Morse code. The discreteness is not in the signal; it is in the DECODER (in Gamma). The carrier is negotiable: speaker, loudness, voicing, and rate are all free parameters the sender chooses, and decoding across senders is decoding through the sender's fist (the sender's idiosyncratic realization of the shared code). A correct decoder commits to the discrete code and treats every continuous carrier value as a serialization of it to be quantized away.
concepts.why: If the message is a discrete code and the carrier is negotiable, then the recogniser's job is to recover the code invariant to the carrier — exactly the relational-invariance the confirmed decoder reads. Treating the discreteness as a property of the decoder (not the signal) explains why a continuous-to-discrete quantiser, not a finer continuous measurement, is the right structure, and why every bottom-up attempt to find discreteness IN the signal returned a null.

concepts.name: composition_is_the_path_to_vocabulary
concepts.definition: Words are COMPOSED admissible structures of sub-word relational units. The decoder confirmed at the sub-lexical scale (relational band-rank units) is a part; a word is a whole determined by its parts plus a finite set of combination rules, realized by composing the sub-word relational units under the unified language engine's grammar (G, Gamma). Scaling from a small confirmed digit vocabulary to a large or continuous vocabulary is therefore a COMPOSITION problem — search/fold over the production space of sub-word units under the compression selector — not a bigger flat exemplar lexicon.
concepts.why: A compositional / generative system's whole is determined by its parts plus a finite set of production rules, so its members are not an enumerated list but an open set realizable by composing parts — a fold / search over the production space under a selection criterion, rather than a fixed table lookup. The exemplar lexicon's accuracy cost that scales with the speaker pool is the signature that a flat table is the wrong object; composition through the unified engine is the (G, Gamma) path to scale.

concepts.name: generative_collapse_recovery_inverts_production
concepts.definition: The relational structure that survives all serializations is the structure of the PRODUCTION process collapsed onto the carrier; every bottom-up, signal-first attempt to find that structure returned a grounded null (acoustic delta/duration, formant extraction, nested discrete events, source/correlogram cochlea). The direction those nulls all point at is GENERATIVE / COLLAPSE recovery: recover the relational structure by INVERTING the forward production model — imagine what you would have said and match it — rather than measuring it bottom-up off the degraded acoustics.
concepts.why: Recovering causes from effects is an inverse problem that needs a forward model (articulation->acoustics) to invert — an internal synthesiser the loop can run and match against. The repeated bottom-up nulls are the evidence that the structure is not legible in the signal alone; it is legible only as the inverse of production. Inverting a forward model is analysis-by-synthesis, the convergent loop the bottom-up dead-ends were implicitly demanding.

concepts.name: filter_graph_library_router_architecture
concepts.definition: The perception architecture is a FILTER-GRAPH of connectable nodes whose admissibility (Gamma) is type-compatibility, wired by the agent itself; perception is unified into the language engine so a decode is a construction in the same composer / library / router / Gamma as language; and runtime self-extension is routine (the agent authored new primitives — XCorrPeak, cepstral_formants — into its own runtime). This gives a LIBRARY of decode-configurations and a ROUTER that selects among them by circumstance, instead of one fixed decode path.
concepts.why: A library of admissible decode-configurations plus a router that composes and selects them by circumstance is the compositional, open form of the perception system — its members are realized by composing parts under a selection criterion, not enumerated. Having built the connectable filter-graph and the runtime self-extension means the agent can compose new decode constructions on demand; the open question is whether routing among configurations by circumstance compresses better than a single decoder.

concepts.name: grounded_nulls_do_not_retread
concepts.definition: Grounded NULL results the session established — directions that did NOT compress and must not be re-tread: acoustic delta and duration features; speaker normalization in every form tried (vocal-tract-length warp, scalar channel, and a 7-dimensional rich estimate); the matched filter (XCorrPeak); source / correlogram cochlea representations (which HARM); formant extraction by LPC, de-jittered, or cepstral (over-quantizes); bottom-up nested discrete events; and re-choosing the audio basis (all bases are approximately log, so the basis is irrelevant to the rank decoder — the cochlea is already log-right).
concepts.why: These were measured and returned no compression payoff: each tried to read the message off the carrier's magnitudes or to re-measure the continuous wave, which is the wrong move given the message is the relational filter structure invariant to the carrier. They are recorded as closed so the agent's selector spends no effort re-deriving them; the lever is relational/generative structure, not finer carrier measurement.

wiring_note: This Mt depends on speech_science: every finding is an order-0 postulate about the same speech phenomenon speech_science maps, written so the agent's implication-harvester extractors (invertibility, parametric_allpole, scale_cancellation, quantize_to_categories, compositional_generativity, forward_inverse, latent_structure) fire on its definition+why text. The agent's order-N derivative differentiates these postulates and its compression selector ranks the resulting gaps; nothing here decides the next direction — the agent's own machinery does.
